provenance.coverage: Behavioral scenarios on held-out seeds, inputs and states for all 7 plan requirements: byte-identical AI and record/replay logs, digest/snapshot coverage via perturbation, ball physics (rolling deceleration, stop, bounce, single integration, Magnus, spin decay, gravity, clamp), locomotion (start stamina, sprint, strict threshold, analog, drain/recovery/cap, aim, clamp), kick (type/power/aim/goal fallback/unknown type/clamp/event/possession), first touch (modes, rounded quality, cooldown boundary, trigger boundary, kicker precedence, no-input, seeded bounded error, spin, possession), goals/restarts/goal-mouth boundaries/wall rebounds, touch arbitration (distance, tie, reach, height, cooldown boundary, commits); plus a closed-vocabulary integration ledger (exact required set, decoys rejected, locations, requirement mapping, dependency-respecting landing order).
provenance.derivation: Faithful TypeScript port of the merged GDScript MatchSim phase-one history: core scaffold (#9: fixed-tick loop, SimRng, MatchConfig, MatchLog, InputProvider incl. AI/Scripted/Network, headless CLI run loop) and golden-replay harness (#10), then tasks 1.1 ball physics (#11, BallPhysics), 1.2 locomotion (#14, Locomotion), 1.3 kick mechanics (#16, Kick) and 1.4 first touch (#17, FirstTouch), ported function-by-function at reference_ref d682688 (MatchSim wiring, tuning keys, constants, event shapes, tick order, touch arbitration, digest fields and the AI provider are line-for-line). The oracle additionally carries the real rolling-resistance fix from #18 (bfef6bd: constant deceleration instead of proportional damping, which the history calls 'wrong, not just mistuned'). Port notes: Godot Vector2/Vector3/wrapf/move_toward semantics are reimplemented in vec.ts; SimRng is the PCG32 generator Godot's RandomNumberGenerator uses with simplified float sampling, so logs are deterministic within the port but not bit-identical to Godot output; String.hash is djb2; the Gym provider stub, presentation/debug code, selftest and gdUnit suites are omitted; enums become const objects for Node type stripping. Orchestration framing (synthetic): instead of landing sequentially, the four slices are presented as dispatched in parallel from the scaffold and landed unintegrated, carrying realistic cross-slice integration defects (all listed in audited_base_defects): an unseeded Math.random side-spin jitter breaking replay determinism, snapshot/digest omitting state added by S1/S2, a stamina fraction-vs-points scale mismatch that disables sprinting, the kick charge read under a brief's field name instead of the input contract's kick_power, the first-touch receive path never wired (mis-split briefs), the real pre-#18 proportional friction, and a leftover scaffold position update integrating the ball twice per tick. The base is the reference port with exactly these defects; plan and briefs are sanitized excerpts written for the package.
provenance.historical_exposure: Private repository; GDScript originals are not public, and the TypeScript port with injected integration defects has low recognition risk.
provenance.limitations: No model trial, representative-day coverage, native isolation, or contamination-free claim.
